project.title: They Call You a Deadbeat for Paying in Full

_comment: This file is the single source of truth for the cut. It is a transcription of the
SCENE MAP, NUMBERS and VOICEOVER sections of credit-card-prompt-pack.txt.
bin/audit.mjs re-reads the pack and fails if the two ever drift apart.
target{In,Out} are the pack's ESTIMATES at ~150wpm. They are not the cut.
bin/align.mjs re-derives real timings from the recorded voiceover and writes
out/timeline.json; everything downstream reads that, never these numbers.
card.at accepts a number (seconds from scene start) or 'vo:<sentence>:<word>',
which pins the card to the moment that word is actually spoken.

scenes.name: hook
vo: The card industry has a word for people who pay in full every month.

scenes.name: the term
vo: That's the actual term. Not an insult. A category.
If you never carry a balance, you were never the customer.

card.note: pack: 'give it the full box - it is the whole hook'

scenes.name: the revolver
vo: The profitable one has a name too. A revolver. Someone who never quite clears it.

scenes.name: the product
vo: So the card isn't the product. The balance is.

scenes.name: the limit
vo: Which is why the limit goes up on its own. You didn't ask. It arrived.

scenes.name: the rewards
vo: Why the cashback exists. One percent back. Twenty-four point nine percent owed.

card.note: pack: most typographic weight in the film

scenes.name: the box
vo: And why the minimum payment gets its own box. The smallest number on the page.
None of that is an accident. That's the design.

scenes.name: the rule
vo: Riba isn't a fee you might trigger. It's the revenue model.

scenes.name: the real sale
vo: A real sale takes its profit once. At the moment of sale. It never grows again.

scenes.name: time
vo: Riba grows while you sleep. Time is the ingredient.

scenes.name: the close
vo: Pay it to zero and you become worthless to them.
Be worthless. Follow — the fix is next.
